response.original_title: {FAQ™Passenger~Addition} Add a Passenger to an already booked Ponant Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger on my Ponant Cruise, call Customer Service directly at ☎+1⇾888⇾315⇾9585 [US]or 【+44-808-196-9697 (UK)】 or reach out to your travel advisor. Because each cabin requires its own booking, an agent will set up a new, ☎+1⇾888⇾315⇾9585 [US]separate reservation. Make sure to ask them to officially link your booking numbers so your group shares the same main dining table and scheduled activities. To add a passenger to your Ponant Cruise booking, contact ☎+1⇾888⇾315⇾9585 [US] or 【+44-808-196-9697 (UK)】Ponant Cruise or your travel advisor as soon as possible.
